body:
This story dates back to the summer of 2013. I was 22 years old, jobless and down in the dumps because a boyfriend had left me. A friend of mine well call A and I were sitting back and enjoying the sunset on the lake and he randomly pulls out what looks to be a wad of toilet paper. He unwraps the toilet paper and reveals a light bulb. He puts some meth into the lightbulb and fires it up. At this point in time I was quite scared of meth and I even walked away from him because I was scared I would inhale the smoke.
The sun had gone down at this point and we decided to go to another friend's house. My friend A pulls out his lightbulb and hands it to our friend J. He smokes the meth and they pass it back and forth and something in my brain clicks and all of a sudden I want to try meth. I remember seeing a bunch of Montana Meth ads against using meth, and how it showed people in filthy and pitiful conditions smoking meth and it really scared me at the time but then I seemed to ignore it. I grabbed the pipe and my friend A lit the lighbulb for me and I hesitated, then proceeded to smoke the meth.
Before the rush even hit me I was thinking a million thoughts at one time. 'What if I become like those people in the ads?' 'Will I become addicted to this?' crossed my mind. I exhaled. For a moment I was in a state of panic because I had just done this really crazy horrible drug and there's no going back now. Then the rush hit and all of those thoughts disappeared. I suddenly felt like I just made a very, very good choice. I felt on top of the world and like nothing could stop me. All of a sudden I had this crazy amount of energy and I wanted to talk to everyone in the room. I Wanted more. Much more. I continued to smoke it with my friends until it ran out and then I went on a quest to get my own dope because I loved the feeling so much.
My friend A comes up with this crazy idea of cooking meth. His friend B had the chemicals and we just needed a box of psuedoephedrine pills to cook our dope. Immediately I get in the car with my friend and we go to the doctor so I can get some allergy meds. I spend nearly a grueling hour in the waiting room trying not to pilfer through my purse or twitch. A nurse finally sees me and takes my vitals and is alarmed at how high my heart rate and pulse are. She gets the doctor to check on me and surprise, its my family doctor I've known since I was a little girl. She asks me why my pupils are so dilated and I tell her its from my bipolar meds and is just a side effect I experience. The paranoia is creeping in at this point. She acts me what I'm there for and I explain to her I'd like allegra D. She says 'you are aware that this medication is used in the production of methamphetamine?' I gulp. 'Oh, I didn't know that' I said nervously. She prescribes the medicine to me eventually and I leave the doctors office.
We make it back to the trailer park and we get ready to cook some dope. We decide to do the 'shake and bake' method. B and I set everything up as A sits back and smokes a couple bowls of meth. B and I get the cook started and A leaves to go to work and leaves me with B. I was extremely paranoid throughout this process and I just wanted it to be over with. It took a total of around 3 hours to complete the cook but we did a successful one. We got roughly 3.5 grams of dope from it. We drink 'Alabama tea' (the chemical residue and the coffee filters mixed with water) and within ten minutes I'm tweaking my balls off. I start drawing a hundred different things, playing with bright colors and graffiti art. A comes back and B and I pack a bowl of meth for him to try and see how we did. The crystals were white and clear and looked a little bit wet. Apparently it was some good shit because A snorted one line and wouldn't stop talking. We smoked bowl after bowl after bowl and some other people showed up for the party.
It was a hit! Everyone was tweaked the fuck out and chewing their tongues by the time they had a couple hits off my dope. We all smoked a gram of it together over the course of a night and I go home with A to have some much needed sex. I'm not going to go into great detail about how good it was, but sex on meth is a whole different ball game than just regular sex. It's just better, no doubt about it.
Eventually my meth use landed me in a mental ward and I quit using the drug for about year and didnt see my friends A or B for a long time. That is until I see A again, and we decide to spend his 10 dollars on some dope. We head to the dope house and I am having all sorts of feelings rise up in me. I was excited to try it again but a little scared too. I didnt want my parents to find out I was back on meth. We finally got to the dope house after a long drive and inside I see a few skinny tweaked out people sitting curled up on the couch. One girl couldnt keep her mouth still if her life depended on it. I wondered how much dope she was on. A buys a point of dope (tenth of a gram) and we get the tin foil and pen ready.
A takes his first hit and I can smell the sweet chemical smoke wafting in the air as he blew out the clouds. He hands the tin foil and pen to me and lights the foil from beneath. Trails of smoke wafted into the air and I inhaled with my pen, chasing the dragon. After that we decide to snort a line. Let me tell you, that shit stings more than anything else I could ever put up my nose, EVER. It literally felt like it was melting my nostril raw and made my brain feel funny. I got so high though that we talked for hours. It literally only felt like thirty minutes. It was getting dark and we ran out of dope so we left to go make some more money. Shortly after we conjure up ten dollars and head back to the dope house to get some more meth. We buy another point off the guy and drive to A's house. We crush the meth and seperate it into two big lines and we snort them. After talking and talking in the car A decides to go inside and get ready for work.
At this point in time I'm coming down off of my meth buzz. Coming down feels like losing the best feeling in the world. And then all I feel is nothingness. It's very depressing, and is the exact opposite of why people take meth in the first place. I have no idea whether I will do meth again or not but I can definitely say that I wish I had never done the drug. I relapsed after a year and a half and I thought by then the cravings for meth would be over, but they weren't, especially when its being smoked right in front of me. Time will only tell whether I do it again or not. I can definitely say to anybody thats thinking about trying meth : Be careful. This drug is extremely addictive and harmful to your health. It sucked me in and I became its slave. I've seen good people turn bad because of this drug and it ruins lives. And not just their life, but everyone's life thats around them.
